answer: Problem: Sybil packs spawn keys that wander across tip graphs until honest stake is diluted. Mechanism: each fresh key posts a falcon bond of 0.18 POA and a zephyr path digest (HMAC-SHA256 of TPM-quote||epoch||addr||3-hop tip sample) that a 7-peer drift jury re-samples every 90 minutes. Cost: 0.18 POA locked 2 epochs plus 4 jury rounds before tip weight unlocks. Verification: tip weight equals jury rounds times unique zephyr digests; clones collapse to one. Failure: reused digest or jury mismatch burns 45% of the falcon bond and zeros weight for the epoch.
